title: DECISION: memzero_explicit used throughout for key material
description: All key-holding struct fields and ioctl op structs are zeroed with memzero_explicit(), not memset() or bzero(). memzero_explicit() is a compiler barrier; the compiler is permitted to elide a plain memset() when the buffer goes out of scope (a documented optimization in GCC/Clang). FIPS 140-3 requires CSPs to be destroyed before memory release. A reviewer who says 'use memset — it's cleaner' is wrong. Do not change to memset.
close_reason: Design decision recorded; no code change needed.
